headline: Your app on one page, for a person who has never seen its code.

figure.fits: A bridge from a stepped cliff of code, over an open gap, to one person standing at its far end: Vyo carries the app across to someone who does not code.

texts.text: **What crosses.** A picture of the project's parts and a few plain words around it, checked for jargon first.

notes.title: How it works
notes.text: Ask your coding agent to explain the app. Vyo reads the project, draws its parts as one picture and writes a few plain words around it.

notes.title: Checked first
notes.text: Every word is checked for jargon, file paths and text that runs into the picture. Each problem is named, so it can be fixed.

notes.title: What you get
notes.text: One PNG and one PDF, sized like a poster. Send it to a client, a manager or a friend who does not code.

notBuilt: files other than PNG and PDF
